verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for an API-driven tax product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows that static API reference pages exist (e.g. the Tax Calculations reference) and that markdown docs and llms.txt are available. Nothing documents an interactive explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
